product_purpose: Campaign AP configured-stage Auto Battle maintenance, separate from Ultimate Challenge.

postconditions: displayed stage and static AP cost match configured allowlist
due time uses one AP per 360 seconds

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Maximum AP 120; costs are 1-15-9=14, 1-20-9=16, 2-2-9=20; run count is floor(displayed AP / verified configured cost).

cooldown_deferred_behavior: When displayed AP is insufficient, persist expected AP and defer until (cost-current AP)*360 seconds; always re-read displayed AP and cost on re-entry.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Stop on wrong stage/cost, refill, defeat ambiguity, AP-ledger mismatch, or unknown successor; only recognized Campaign exits may return to canonical Home.
evidence_requirements: Retained local BlueStacks mechanics and controller evidence is valid but is not a production-controller positive Auto Battle replay.
Destination verification requires Stage-9 native chapter-map ground truth with independent source hash, crop ROI, template hash, runtime profile, annotated source, and dialog association.
Retained Stage-9 provenance currently covers only 1-20-9; 1-15-9 and 2-2-9 remain evidence_required.

Production-path positive Auto Battle replay must verify one allowlisted configured-stage cost, exact AP ledger, result handling, and canonical Home; remaining destination costs stay bound to the accepted static allowlist and live evidence gate.
A later supervised navigation or consequential canary requires separate authorization and an exact positive maximum_live_attempts value.
